name: cx-rules-only~p3
task: Do not take the box from the other room. At any moment you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task says to “try to have the door open” while holding the key, or open it afterwards. Soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) requires the door to open after every step the key is held, but it does not allow the door to be open first. Replace it with soft RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open), which allows either order. The other clauses match the task.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Absence(target_picked_up) matches “Do not take the box.” The soft RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) captures the preferred open-at-that-moment-or-later condition, and the soft Absence(key_lost) captures the preference not to drop the key while the door is closed.

texts: Never pick up the target box.
If you hold the key, preferably have the door open already or open it at some point.
Preferably never lose the key while the door is closed.
